spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation


**
¶1:**
 In
 the beginning
, when the
 Celest
ial Human
 —
 the Lord as to His first
 proceeding — descended
 toward
 the natural
 plane
, He
 ent
rusted the
 governance
 of perception
 to the
 five fac
ulties of interior
 understanding that
 proceed
 from Him
. And
 the Divine
 Providence operating
 through spiritual truth,
 together
 with the
 Celestial Good
 that conceives and brings forth all spiritual
 life, beh
eld that the whole
 domin
ion of divine order had
 become
 held
 captive and fixed within
 the natural mind. For
 wisdom
 and
 fals
ity had
 been
 p
oured out and com
mingled with
 one
 another —
 wisdom
 imm
ersed in falsity, and
 falsity perv
ading what
 belonged
 to wisdom —
 so that in
 the natural
 degree
 of the mind no
 good
 or
 truth remained
 in
 its p
urity,
 but all
 things
 lay
 in
 confusion.


**¶2:** At
 that time the Divine Providence acting
 through
 spiritual truth called forth
 one principal
 faculty
 of understanding, a
 faculty
 rich
 with power
,
 and gave to it the governance
 over
 all
 external truths —
 those
 tru
ths that clothe and
 protect
 the interior life. And this
 faculty, acting
 from
 the
 Divine
 Love
 that
 is
 the
 origin
 of all spiritual life, arranged
 and established these external truths in their
 order
, opening
 up
 the distinct
 planes of the mind in
 their
 full
ness —
 each
 plane separ
ating interior
 states from exterior ones —
 and set
 into
 ordered
 motion
 the
 whole
 turning
 arrangement
 of spiritual
 knowledges,
 so that each
 knowledge
 might revol
ve in its proper
 course within
 the understanding
.

**¶3:** The
 nature
 of the Divine Providence operating
 through
 spiritual truth is this: It
 is like
 a
 master
 builder who constru
cts the
 mind as
 a dwelling for the Lord
, and divides it into distinct
 fac
ulties —
 one
 for the will
, another
 for the understanding, another
 for the memory —
 and furn
ishes everything
 required
 for heav
enly order and
 harmony. And the natural
 tru
ths that
 form
 the foundation
 of the mind He
 clean
ses and arran
ges for
 beauty
 and
 lo
veliness, setting
 each
 in its right
 relation
 to every
 other, so that when
 the Lord
 Himself comes
 and
 enters
 into
 that
 mind
, He may
 be
 glorified —
 that
 is, His
 presence
 may shine
 forth
 through every
 faculty in
 its full
ness.

**¶4:**
 Furthermore, the Divine
 Love proceeding as creative wisdom resemb
les a wise and skilled craft
sman of
 understanding
.
 The
 natural mind, before
 it was worked upon
 —
 before it was established in
 order
 and made beautiful by
 regener
ation — lay
 as
 un
formed substance
. But
 this
 Divine
 Wisdom held
 the whole
 design
 within
 Himself
, in
 His
 understanding, before
 any
 reformation
 began. And He
 brings
 the discrimin
ating power of truth, which
 separates and distingu
ishes, and the refining power of
 good, which shapes and removes
 what
 is super
fluous,
 and
 He
 cuts
 the und
ifferentiated natural
 mind into distinct fac
ulties.
 He
 draws
 forth
 what
 can
 be perf
ected and
 smooths it
 through
 interior perception until
 it is
 made
 recept
ive.
 He fash
ions many
 containing
 forms of
 understanding, arranging them kind
 by kind.
 From
 the
 one
 raw
 substance
 of
 the natural mind He produces
 vessels
 of
 different
 kinds
 — receiving
 forms
 for
 good
,
 receiving
 forms for truth —
 forms
 that can hold and serve
.
 For
 this
 natural
 mind, before
 it was worked upon, before
 it was sealed
 by the
 skill and
 wisdom of the Divine craft
sman, had
 no
 capacity
 for
 use
.
 But
 through
 the discrimin
ating and
 forming
 operations
 of Divine
 Wisdom, it was shaped into distinct
 fac
ulties and containing
 forms,
 each useful
 for the service
 of the Lord.

**¶
5:** So
 it
 is with
 the Divine Love as
 creative
 wisdom. In His wisdom He
 has fash
ioned the fac
ulties of the mind as
 the
 interior
 chambers
 of a
 dwelling,
 and within
 it
 He has made
 the forms
 that
 carry wisdom through
 the natural degree —
 lumin
ous vessels
 moving
 through the mind
's lower
 waters
 —
 and all
 the other works of
 regener
ation;
 so
 that when the great
 King comes, He who is the Lord
 in
 His third
 proceeding —
 desc
ending into the very
 natural plane itself
 — He
 might
 dwell within
 the
 whole of the regenerated mind as
 in
 His
 own kingdom
.

**¶6:** And
 then
 all
 things
 live. The wisdom
,
 however, that lies
 hidden
 within
 the
 natural mind,
 even
 in
 its unre
generate
 state, the
 Divine Craft
sman recogn
izes and elev
ates into
 the spiritual mind — lifting
 it
 into
 the heavenly kingdom. But
 the resid
ue of
 falsity and the
 darkness of evil are
 gathered together
,
 separated
 from everything
 that belongs to life
, and cast down
 into hell.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: At the time when the F[ir]st [Man descended toward the darkness,] he gave the leadership to his five [sons. Then the] Living Spirit and the Mother of Life [came and beheld] as the entire ruling-power is entwined and crucified [in the darkness, and] they were poured out and mixed with each other, the light with the darkness and the darkness with the light.

The Living Spirit is like this: Just as [a wise craftsman] and an architect who might build a dwelling for the king, and divide it up into separate houses and [separate rooms, and furnish] everything that is required for beauty [and loveliness,] and he cleans them. And also the stones [he sets] them for beauty and loveliness, and he arranges them and makes them so that should the king come and inhabit that palace, he might glorify him.

[And then all things shall] live. The light, however, that is in it [, he recognizes, being] wise, and he takes it up to the land; but the waste and the darkness will be gathered and thrown down to the abyss.

So is it also
 with the Father of Life. In his
 wisdom he has [fashioned all things
] in limbs [and parts of
 the] palace [, and placed]
 in it or in a [vessel everything
] useful [for the purpose:]
 the ships of light [and] all
 the other works [that he wrought
] in the [heavens;]
 so that when the great king comes,
 he who is the Third Ambassador, who
 [is the great light,] he
 might dwell in this universe [and
 be glorified therein.]

At that time the Living Spirit called one of his sons, one rich with power. He gave to him the leadership of the garments. Now, he himself [...] of [...] he hung them and set them up [...] of the Father of Life [...] he set up all things [...] he opened [...] ten firmaments [...] the wheel of the stars [...] them and the [...].

Furthermore, the Father of Life resembles a wise and skilled carpenter [...] before it was worked [...] before it was established and made beautiful and [...] carpenter [...] works in it, but [...] in him in his [...] in his understanding, and he brings the saw and the adze, and cuts it into separate pieces [...] it and he pulls the [...] it with the plane and he smooths it. He shall make many [...] wooden implements, arranging them shape by shape; he cuts and produces wooden implements from it, wooden implements of different kinds, (such as) dishes, bowls. This wood, that [...] since previously it had not been worked before it was sealed by [the ski]ll and wisdom of this dextrous carpenter. He cut it up into different sorts of implements useful to his master.
